g.text: A home wearing a hand-knit jumper; its yarn
runs on to the next house. Georgia.
Three roofs drawn without lifting the yarn.
Slab serif (Rockwell-like).
A single knit stitch — two loops holding each
other — doubles as a map pin. Georgia italic on
pine.
A ball of yarn that unrolls into a street of
homes. Futura — geometric, friendly.
A map pin dressed for winter in a striped
bobble hat. Gill Sans on sky.
Nine houses, one in yarn: the place that fits
you. Baskerville — bookish, editorial.
Two grey houses tied by one loop of red yarn —
lights on. American Typewriter.
Two crossed knitting needles make the roof over
a knitted home. Bodoni.
A striped scarf in the bend of the Thames —
London, wrapped up warm.

svg.text: wordmark only · the gap is stitched

g.text: No symbol: the two words are sewn together and
the i's dot is a ball of yarn. Rockwell.
